name: Pontianak
origin: Woman who died in childbirth (Malay cognate of Kuntilanak).
behavior: Banana-tree and riverside haunting; long nails; scent of frangipani then foul odour.
deterrents: Nail driven into the neck hole (classic Malay lore); prayers.

name: Kuntilanak Merah
origin: Violent or unjust death variant of Kuntilanak, marked by the red dress.
behavior: More aggressive haunting; appears at roads and abandoned houses.
deterrents: Prayers; iron / protective amulets in popular retellings.

name: Nyai Blorong
morphology: Serpent / naga hybrid (woman above, snake below)
origin: Wealth-granting serpent queen in pesugihan lore, servant of Nyi Roro Kidul in some tellings.
behavior: Grants riches in exchange for a life-price over time.
deterrents: Breaking the pact is said to be fatal; ritual counsel sought.

name: Dewi Lanjar
origin: Guardian queen of the north coast and its jin realms in Pekalongan lore.
behavior: Rules coastal spirits; grants or withholds favour to fishers and traders.
deterrents: Offerings and respect for coastal taboos.

name: Nyi Pelet
origin: Embodiment of pelet love-magic; a beautiful woman whose charm compels obsession.
behavior: Causes unnatural infatuation and ruin of households.
deterrents: Counter-magic and prayers by a dukun.

name: Calon Arang
origin: Widow of Girah (12th-c. legend) whose black magic brought plague when her daughter was shunned.
behavior: Sends teluh pestilence; dances with corpses in graveyards.
deterrents: Defeated, in legend, by Mpu Bharadah's disciple stealing her magic book.

name: Kolor Ijo
origin: Modern urban-legend predator demon in green underwear, reported in 2000s Java.
behavior: Attacks women at night; climbs into houses.
deterrents: Community patrols and prayers in popular accounts.

name: Pastur Kepala Buntung
origin: Headless Dutch-era priest said to haunt Jeruk Purut cemetery.
behavior: Wanders the cemetery at night carrying his head / seeking his grave.

name: Hantu Jeruk Purut
origin: Cemetery haunting cluster at TPU Jeruk Purut, Jakarta.
behavior: Night-time apparitions near old graves and banyan trees.

name: Kereta Hantu Manggarai
origin: Ghost train said to run the Manggarai–Bogor line, linked to the 1987 Bintaro crash in popular memory.
behavior: Appears as a driverless train on the tracks at night.

name: Hantu Ambulans Bandung
origin: Ambulance from a Dutch-era house on Jl. Bahureksa, Bandung, said to move and sound its siren by itself.
behavior: Siren heard at night; vehicle found moved.
deterrents: None specific; house is a local landmark tale.

name: Mak Lampir
origin: Witch-queen popularised nationally by the Misteri Gunung Merapi TV serial.
behavior: Commands demons and seeks power / revenge from her mountain lair.
deterrents: Heroic counter-magic in the serial's lore.

name: Grandong
origin: Wealth familiar kept for pesugihan; said to demand milk and blood offerings.
behavior: Brings money to its keeper; sickens household members over time.
deterrents: Destroying the keeping ritual / religious counsel.

name: Pocong Merah
origin: Aggressive red-shrouded pocong variant in contemporary urban legend.
behavior: Hops and chases; associated with violent death.

name: Orang Bunian
origin: Hidden people living in forests and empty houses in Malay lore; weddings heard but unseen.
behavior: Music and cooking smells from empty places; people who follow them may vanish in time.

name: Hantu Galah
origin: Tall pole-ghost of Malay lore whose legs span roads and rivers.
behavior: Straddles paths; grows taller the more it is watched (cf. Begu Ganjang).

name: Hantu Tinggi
origin: Giant tall ghost of Malay forest lore.
behavior: Seen towering over trees at forest edges.
deterrents: Prayers; avoidance of forest at dusk.

name: Hantu Kopek
origin: Female apparition in roadside urban legend, named for its exposed form.
behavior: Appears to lone male travellers at night, then vanishes.

name: Hantu Rimba
origin: Generic forest spirit / keeper of the rimba in Malay-Indonesian usage.
behavior: Punishes disrespect to the forest; misleads intruders.
deterrents: Permission rituals and offerings before entering forest.

name: Mambang
origin: Class of Malay elemental spirits (e.g., Mambang Kuning of the sunset).
behavior: Inhabits natural phenomena; invoked in traditional healing.

name: Putri Tangguk
origin: Woman in Jambi legend who neglected her rice / children and was cursed.
behavior: Appears near rice fields combing long hair; weeping.

name: Mariaban
origin: Giant red-haired forest being of Kalimantan river lore.
behavior: Hunts along rivers; immensely strong.

name: Hantu Banyu
origin: Water ghost of Banjar rivers (banyu = water).
behavior: Pulls swimmers and bathers under at dusk.
deterrents: Prayers before bathing; avoid rivers at maghrib.

name: Anak Sima
origin: Child familiar kept for wealth / power in Kalimantan black-magic lore.
behavior: Kept and fed by its keeper; brings luck at a price.
deterrents: Religious counsel; destroying the keeping objects.

name: Hantu Buaya Putih
origin: White crocodile as transformed person / river guardian in widespread river lore.
behavior: Appears as an albino crocodile that behaves like a human.
deterrents: Offerings; do not harm a white crocodile.

name: Memedi
origin: Generic Javanese fright-spirit (memedi = that which frightens).
behavior: Takes whatever form most frightens the witness.
deterrents: Courage / prayers; form dissolves when faced calmly in tales.

name: Tonya
origin: Guardian spirit of a place (tonya) in South Sulawesi usage.
behavior: Guards houses, trees and heirlooms; punishes theft.

name: Naga Besukih
origin: Cosmic naga of Balinese lore whose scales are said to become gold / wealth.
behavior: Dwells in Mount Agung's realm; guards balance of the world.

name: Parakang
origin: South Sulawesi flying-head / organ-eater, cognate of Palasik and Kuyang.
behavior: Transforms at night; attacks pregnant women and infants.
deterrents: Garlic, sharp objects by the bed; expose the empty body.

name: Pokpok
origin: Witch form named for its 'pok-pok' sound in flight in South Sulawesi lore.
behavior: Flies at night making pok-pok sounds; seeks pregnant victims.

name: Longga
origin: Tall stretching ghost of Sulawesi lore, cognate of Hantu Galah / Begu Ganjang.
behavior: Grows taller when watched; haunts paths.

name: Waruga spirit
origin: Ancestral presence tied to waruga stone burial sarcophagi of Minahasa.
behavior: Guards ancestral burial grounds.
deterrents: Respect and offerings at waruga sites.

name: Jin Qarin
origin: Companion jin (qarin) said in Islamic tradition to accompany every person from birth.
behavior: Whispers temptation; mimics its human after death in popular lore.

name: Preta
morphology: Gaunt hungry ghost (small mouth, huge belly)
origin: Hungry ghost of Hindu-Buddhist cosmology, retained in Javanese / Balinese heritage.
behavior: Wanders unable to eat or drink; fed by merit-transfer offerings.
deterrents: Offerings and prayers for the dead.

name: Hantu Air
origin: Generic water ghost (hantu air) of rivers, lakes and wells across the Malay-Indonesian world.
behavior: Drowns the careless; rises at dusk and in floods.
deterrents: Prayers; pawang mediation; avoid water at dusk.

name: Aswang
origin: Umbrella Filipino viscera-sucker; long proboscis tongue in many tellings.
behavior: Shapeshifts by day, hunts by night; tiktik sound grows fainter as it nears.

name: Tikbalang
origin: Horse-headed trickster of Philippine forests.
behavior: Misleads travellers; causes disorientation.
deterrents: Wear shirt inside-out; ask permission to pass.

name: Phi Tai Hong
origin: Ghost of a person who died violently / suddenly in Thai belief.
behavior: Among the most feared and powerful phi; haunts the death site.

name: Churel
origin: Woman who died in childbirth / by injustice in South Asian lore; cognate motif to Kuntilanak.
behavior: Seduces and drains young men; haunts burial and liminal places.
deterrents: Iron, burial with thorns / rites in folk accounts.

name: Aul
origin: Headless being of Kalimantan forest lore, said to carry its head.
behavior: Roams forest paths at night.

name: Lelembut
origin: Class of subtle Javanese spirits, often invisible, associated with refined places.
behavior: Possesses or influences people quietly in kejawen lore.

name: Siluman
origin: Generic term for a transformed being / were-creature across Indonesian lore.
behavior: Lives hidden among humans in animal or human form.

name: Dedemit
origin: Guardian spirit of wild / empty places (alas) in Javanese lore.
behavior: Demands respect and offerings from those who clear land.

name: Hantu Penunggu
morphology: Guardian spirit of a place / building
origin: Generic 'waiting / guarding' ghost (penunggu) of houses, trees, bridges and sites.
behavior: Makes its presence felt when its place is disturbed.

name: Matianak
origin: Kalimantan name / cognate for the childbirth-death ghost (mati anak = died in childbirth).
behavior: Haunts trees and riversides; attacks pregnant women and men.
deterrents: Prayers; protective iron in folk lore.

name: Pocong Gundul
origin: Bald-headed pocong variant popularised by contemporary Indonesian horror film.
behavior: Hops and pursues victims from a haunted school / site in film lore.

name: Hantu Pusako
origin: Guardian tied to Minangkabau ancestral heirloom property and houses (rumah gadang).
behavior: Punishes those who wrongfully sell or divide pusako land.

name: Kambe
origin: Wild man / hairy humanoid of West Sulawesi highland lore.
behavior: Shy, avoids villages; raids gardens in some accounts.
deterrents: None specific — biological entity in witness accounts.

name: Orang Gigi
origin: Forest humanoid in Sumatran local lore, grouped here as a regional cryptid report.
behavior: Avoids humans; leaves tracks near rivers.
